statements.status_notes: WBITT Network Multitool includes apache2-utils client and administration tools such as ab and htpasswd, but does not include apache2/httpd, Apache server modules, or suexec. This finding concerns the Apache mod_negotiation HTTP-server module, which is absent from the shipped utility payload. See https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2008-0456
